_comment: SHARED, AUTHORITATIVE list of plugin ids that must NEVER appear in
these ids from its plugins.allow enumeration before assigning it.
THE LIST IS EMPTY. It used to hold 'anthropic' (the no-Anthropic rule);
Trevor removed that rule on 2026-10-29, and scripts/repair-model-sovereignty.sh
no longer strips the anthropic provider, plugin entry or plugins.allow id. An
Anthropic plugin installed or enabled on a box is now kept like any other.
Matching, if an id is ever added, is EXACT (id.strip().lower() == entry).
FAIL-OPEN: a missing or unreadable file makes the enumerator print a WARNING and
subtract nothing; it never treats a missing file as an empty allowlist.
